name: Suzhou Xianglou New Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Xianglou New Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of customized precision stamping new materials. The company provides precision stamping materials for automotive parts for use in structural and functional components in automotive safety systems, seating systems, interior systems, and powertrain systems. It also provides technical consulting services; and researches and develops new metallic materials. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Suzhou, China.
